items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: He has shared the stage with Ray Charles, Lionel Hampton and Count Basie... Lionel Hampton had a trumpet player in the band, used to always send me messages.

ctx.x: Were people like Lionel Hampton and Cab Calloway, were they people that you learned from?

Big time, big influence. I know Cab Calloway’s grandson. He runs a band. You know that don’t you, Cab Calloway’s. Lionel Hampton, he used to call me “Bubba.” You know about that? Everyone was “Bubba.” But Gladys Hampton ran the business, his wife. You know that.
